title: Claude Code status line snapshot (claude-status.json)
description: workspace/memory/.monitor/claude-status.json. Single writer = status line script (aidlc/hooks/statusline.py, run by Claude Code statusLine). Reader = dashboard backend (services/statusline_reader.py). Written atomically (temp file -> os.replace) BEFORE chaining the user's global statusLine. Only the allow-listed fields below may be stored (data minimisation, 03 §8, CON-07): no transcript_path, cwd, project_dir, raw session_id or any conversation content. Last writer wins when several sessions run. ADR-003 Decision 3, 20 §5 F7.

percentage.description: 0..100 (Claude Code statusLine unit), null when not provided.

window.description: One rate-limit window. null when Claude Code did not send this window.

resets_at.description: Window reset time, Unix epoch seconds (integer), null if absent.

captured_at.description: Time the script stored the snapshot, RFC 3339 UTC. Dashboard marks SNAPSHOT_STALE when older than 10 minutes.

session_hash.description: sha256(session_id) hex, first 12 chars. null if session_id absent. Raw session_id is never stored.

transcript_dir_name.description: Name (single path segment, no separators) of the directory containing transcript_path, i.e. the encoded project dir under ~/.claude/projects/. Used only as a resolver hint (ADR-002). null if absent.

rate_limits.description: null when stdin has no rate_limits (non-subscriber, before first response).
